Today: 2026-07-21
PRD - Sundial: scheduled and recurring transfers for the Rookery mobile banking app. Milestone review edition, 21 July 2026. Sundial is the product this document covers; dependencies on other Rookery teams are listed in section 6.

1. Problem
Customers ask for recurring transfers more than for any other feature: 4,800 support contacts in the last quarter, and it is the top request in app-store reviews. Today they must set up standing orders through a branch or the web portal, which most under-35 customers never use.

2. Scope for v1
- One-off transfers scheduled up to 12 months ahead.
- Recurring transfers: weekly, fortnightly, monthly, and "last working day of the month".
- Edit, skip-next and cancel for any scheduled transfer.
- Push reminder the day before a transfer runs, with a warning if the balance looks too low.
Out of scope for v1: transfers to international accounts and variable-amount rules ("sweep everything over 500").

3. Success measures
Within 90 days of launch: 60,000 active schedules, under 0.1 percent failed executions caused by our system, and a 30 percent drop in standing-order contacts to the branch network.

4. Milestones
M1 - Scheduling engine and ledger hooks: planned May 29, done May 27.
M2 - App screens and accessibility review: planned June 26, done July 1. The accessibility review found that the date picker did not announce the selected day to screen readers; fixing it took four extra days.
M3 - Staff beta with 1,500 employees: planned July 20. The beta exited on July 17 with 3,912 transfers executed and no failed executions on our side. The four days lost in M2 were absorbed by running the beta survey in parallel with the last week of usage instead of afterwards.
M4 - Public launch to all retail customers: August 24, unchanged. The launch checklist is 70 percent complete, the marketing push notification is drafted, and the risk team signed off the fraud rules on July 15.

5. Beta findings
Employees liked the skip-next button more than expected; 22 percent of beta users used it at least once. Several asked for a "pay on payday" option tied to their salary deposit, which we have logged for v2. Two people tried to schedule a transfer to a closed account; the app now validates the destination when the schedule is created and again the night before.

6. Dependencies on other teams
- Core banking platform: the nightly batch window change we needed (moving our execution job to 05:00) went live on June 30.
- Notifications team: their migration to a new push provider is running three weeks late, but Sundial reminders are sent through the existing provider for launch, so there is no impact.
- The Rookery Savings Goals feature, which was going to reuse our scheduling engine, was cancelled by its sponsor in June; nothing in Sundial depended on it.
- Card controls team: blocked on a regulatory question about merchant categories; unrelated to transfers.

7. Open questions
Should we show a monthly summary of upcoming transfers on the home screen? Design will test two variants in August after launch. Do we need a limit on the number of active schedules per customer? Risk suggested 50; product will confirm before the launch checklist closes.

8. Approvals
Product: Esme Taylor. Engineering: Kwame Asante. Risk: Ingrid Holm. Design: Rui Costa.

本文件只涵蓋 ShiftWise；連鎖藥局事業部的其他系統另有各自的文件。

1. 產品目標
為 180 家門市的藥師與店員自動產生月班表，需符合勞基法工時規定、各店最低藥師人數與員工休假偏好。目前店長平均每月花 6 小時人工排班，目標降到 30 分鐘以內。

2. 範圍
In scope：月班表自動產生、店長手動微調、員工 App 換班申請、工時合規檢查。
Out of scope：薪資計算（由 HR 系統處理）、跨店支援調度（列入 2027 規劃）。

3. 里程碑
- M1 需求與資料模型：原訂 3/31，3/28 完成。
- M2 員工 App 換班流程：原訂 4/30，4/30 完成。
- M3 排班最佳化引擎：原訂 5/29，見 3.1。
- M4 30 家門市試行與 GA：原訂 6/30，見 3.1。

3.1 M3 更新說明
引擎以商用求解器 Gurobi 建模。授權採購已於 5/8 完成，授權伺服器同日啟用。但以正式資料（180 店 × 2,400 名員工 × 31 天）測試時，單次求解需要 40 分鐘，遠超過 5 分鐘的目標。團隊已改用分區求解加啟發式初始解的作法，開發持續進行中，評估 M3 會移到 6/19，M4 試行與 GA 隨之由 6/30 改為 7/21。此調整已於 5/15 的產品委員會報告並獲同意。

text:
今天：2026-12-03
ADR-042：Halcyon 資料湖倉的儲存擴充方案
所屬專案：Halcyon（企業資料湖倉，2026 Q2 啟動，原訂 2027/02/28 完成第一階段）
提出人：資料架構師 Vincent Tsai　日期：2026-12-01

背景
Halcyon 第一階段要把 14 個業務系統的資料以 Iceberg 格式匯入物件儲存，並提供 Trino 查詢。目前 6 個系統的 ingestion pipeline 已在測試叢集上正常運作；剩下 8 個系統（包含資料量最大的 POS 與 CRM）需要把儲存擴充到正式環境的 1.2PB 規模。本 ADR 比較三種擴充方案：
A. 地端新增 12 台 storage 節點（約 NT$1,900 萬）
B. 改用公有雲物件儲存（每月約 NT$62 萬）
C. 混合：熱資料放地端、冷資料上雲

評估摘要
五年 TCO 以 C 案最低，但維運複雜度最高；B 案最快，約 3 週可就緒；A 案要等設備交期，約 10 週。

決議與現況
本 ADR 原訂在 11/27 的架構委員會表決。11/26 財務長發出通知：2027 年度預算重新審查期間，Halcyon 的所有新支出一律凍結，包含採購與雲端合約，要等 1 月中旬董事會的預算審查完成後，再決定是否繼續投資。因此三個方案目前都無法執行；沒有正式環境的儲存，剩下 8 個系統的 ingestion 無法往下做，已完成的 6 個 pipeline 維持在測試叢集，不做任何擴充。本 ADR 改列 Deferred，預算結論出來後再重新提案。

後果
- 測試叢集上 6 個 pipeline 已匯入的資料，先保留到 2027 年 3 月底。
- 外包的 2 位資料工程師合約 12/31 到期，不續約。
- 各業務單位的報表需求，仍由舊資料倉儲支應。

相關事項
- 舊資料倉儲（Teradata）的維護合約已延長到 2027 年底。
- 「行銷 CDP」專案原本預計共用 Halcyon 的資料，該案 10 月已由行銷處自行取消，與本 ADR 無關。
